Mark your calendar — this Sunday the Ranchero Room becomes a holiday art studio and you're the main event 🎨✨ Art With Aubrey is back at Azucar, guiding you brushstroke by brushstroke through your very own hand-painted Christmas bulbs — poinsettias, snowflakes, pine trees, whatever your heart (and your wine glass) decides. Zero experience needed, just show up ready to sip and create something you'll actually want to hang on the tree. Seats fill fast for these nights, and once the easels are set, that's it. Grab your spot before December 6th sneaks up on you 🥂🎄

📅 Sunday, December 6, 2026 | 6PM–8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $33

Picture it: soft chatter, clinking glasses, paintbrushes gliding over glass bulbs while the room smells like wine and fresh paint 🎨🥂 That's Sunday night at Azucar. Art With Aubrey walks you through turning a plain ornament into a tiny holiday masterpiece — snowy pines, blue snowflakes, gold poinsettias — while you sip something delicious and let your shoulders drop for two hours straight. It's slow, it's sparkly, it's the kind of night where time feels softer. By the end you'll have a handful of bulbs that are completely, unmistakably yours, hanging proof that December 6th was a good one 🎄✨

Bring your mess, bring your magic, bring whoever you want — the Ranchero Room's got room for all of it 💛🎨 Sip and Paint with Art With Aubrey isn't about talent, it's about showing up exactly as you are and leaving with something you made with your own two hands. Crooked snowflake? Lopsided pine tree? Doesn't matter — it's yours, and it's perfect. Come solo and make new friends over shared paint palettes, or round up your whole crew for a Sunday that feels like a warm hug before the holidays hit full speed. Everybody's welcome at this table 🥂🎄
